name: Lachhubhai Ganthiyawala
why_it_matters: The defining address for Bhavnagar's most famous local dish — pav gathiya, a Saurashtra answer to Mumbai's vada pav. Family-run since 1951, with three outlets (Ghogha Circle original, Rupani, Meghani). The watery onion chutney is the part everyone tries to replicate and nobody quite gets right.
insider_tip: Ghogha Circle is the original outlet — go there first. Plate the gathiya yourself with the chutney; don't let them pre-mix. Pav gathiya is breakfast or 5 PM snack, not a sit-down meal — eat standing or take to the beachfront.

name: Rasoi Dining Hall
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor #2 of 60+ Bhavnagar restaurants (4.2/5) — the city's most consistent unlimited-thali address at ₹250-300 per head. Sits behind Galaxy Cinema in Kalanala, opposite Collector Office; central enough for a family lunch between Takhteshwar and Nilambag visits.
insider_tip: Refills are unlimited and the staff is aggressive about it — pace yourself or they'll fill plates before you finish. Lunch (12-3 PM) is the busiest window; dinner is calmer.
signature_address: Opposite Collector Office, behind Galaxy Cinema, Kalubha Road, Kalanala, Bhavnagar 364001

name: Nilambag Palace Restaurant
signature_dish: Royal Gohil-dynasty dining in the Darbar Hall
why_it_matters: Bhavnagar's only heritage fine-dining experience — palace built 1859 by Maharaja Takhatsinhji, designed by German architect Simms in 1879, converted to a heritage hotel in 1984. The Darbar Dining Hall has the original Czechoslovakian chandeliers and Burma teak banquet tables; the royal family's signature dishes are available with prior notice.
insider_tip: Call 24 hours ahead to request the royal family's heritage menu — it isn't on the standard à la carte. The pure-veg restaurant is separate from the main multi-cuisine dining hall; specify when booking. Smart-casual dress code holds.

name: Blue Coriander The Restaurant
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor's current #1-ranked Bhavnagar restaurant (4.8/5, ~26 reviews). The strong rating-to-review-count ratio signals a consistent kitchen — useful as a dinner pick when you've done thali for lunch.
insider_tip: Smaller venue than Rasoi or Rangoli — reserve a weekend table ahead. Best for Chinese-leaning meals; if you want Gujarati thali, go elsewhere.

name: Rangoli Resort Restaurant
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor #4 of 60+ Bhavnagar restaurants (4.2/5, ~94 reviews) — the city's highest-reviewed multi-cuisine restaurant by volume. Resort setting with garden seating; the default group-dinner pick for families combining city sightseeing with a relaxed meal.
insider_tip: Best for evening dinner with kids — open lawn area accommodates running around. Lunch is quieter; book a poolside or garden table.

name: Havmor Eatery
why_it_matters: Tripadvisor #11 of 60+ Bhavnagar restaurants (4.3/5, ~22 reviews) — the local outlet of Gujarat's homegrown Havmor brand (founded 1944 in Karachi, now Ahmedabad-based). The default kid-friendly stop in town for ice cream + pizza after a long sightseeing day.
insider_tip: Treat as an ice-cream stop with food on the side, not the other way around. The mango-pineapple sundae is the signature; pizza is competent but not special.
